Rita: FYI ran into parity issues while wiring the onboarding sample app — python SDK missing admin.rateLimits.list binding, docs only show raw curl.
Noah: that path sounds new. What did you call?
Rita: client.admin.rateLimits.list(org_id="org_xyz") -> AttributeError. curl works: GET /v1/admin/rate-limits?org_id=org_xyz returns JSON.
Ben: Also saw mismatch in retry semantics: server sends 429 + Retry-After but SDK RetryError has no retry_after field, so our client-side backoff ignores server hint and retries too fast.
Rita: repro snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client=RedwoodClient(os.getenv('REDWOOD'))
client.admin.rateLimits.list(org_id='org_xyz')
```
Logs show headers with "retry-after": "12" but exception omits it.
Noah: Two fixes: regen SDK bindings from OpenAPI (admin routes) and update RetryPolicy to parse Retry-After and attach to exceptions. I'll take regen.
sdk-bot: Issue DEVEX-4022 created: "python-sdk admin.rateLimits binding missing + retry-after not surfaced" assigned to Noah.
Ben: Heads up — REST payload uses field name window_seconds but SDK models rename to window; that's parameter/shape drift and broke the demo UI. We should preserve server keys or add aliases.
Rita: I'll patch the sample-app to handle both names temporarily and add an integration test.
Noah: Will run TS SDK gen too to check parity and add a short checklist in the PR. ETA tomorrow morning.
Ben: :thumbsup: please add a migration note about window_seconds vs window and include release instructions for Dedicated customers who pin SDK versions.
